fields.name: Id
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1859A60 allocates 0x10 bytes, IncRefs a FixedString and stores it at +0; destructor bg3.exe+0x185C6C0 DecRefs +0 and frees. The value comes from bg3.exe+0x18551E0: the template's FixedString at +0x10 (SE: GameObjectTemplate::Id), or the result of FUN_143c5e880(template Id, a FixedString of another component of the entity) in one branch. Confirmed: the object written there is {IncRef'd FixedString at +0, 8-byte template pointer at +8}.

fields.name: _Pad4
fields.evidence: alignment; never written by creator/setter (bg3.exe+0x1853E90), varies between two probe passes of the same instances = uninitialised.

fields.name: Template
fields.evidence: Toolkit accessor 'get Template : ls::SplineTemplate const *' at +8; the game agrees: bg3.exe+0x1859A60 and setter bg3.exe+0x1853E90 store the template pointer (the object whose vtable is called in bg3.exe+0x18551E0) at +8; probe shows a heap pointer in all instances.

fields.name: _Pad10
fields.evidence: Not part of the object: the registry size of an object stored behind a pointer is the object's size + 8 (convention of ecl::CameraLockTrigger and the other pointer-held types). bg3.exe+0x1859A60 allocates the object with 0x10 bytes (FUN_1441BEB10(..., 0x10, ...)) and stores only its pointer in an 8-byte ECS slot (ComponentFrameStorageAllocRaw(storage, 8, ...)); live samples past +0x10 hold unrelated heap data.

open_questions: Exact meaning of the FixedString (plain template Id vs. a combined/level-scoped id built by FUN_143c5e880).
No SE type for ls::SplineTemplate exists, hence void*.
Needs the proxy form of declaration (object behind a pointer) in the generator, as for the triggers.
status_reason: the raw check failed: client: registered size 24, layout says 16; server: registered size 24, layout says 16
second_pass: Settled on Windows: bg3.exe+0x1859A60 allocates a 16-byte object {FixedString Id, SplineTemplate*} and stores only its pointer in an 8-byte ECS slot, so the registered 24 is object + 8; size set to 24 with class_size 16, as for other pointer-held types.
